sources.note: Proclamation 7 August 1949, the Aceh, South Sulawesi and South Kalimantan risings, the 1957 estimates, the ends of 1959, 1962 and 1965.

notes: A rebel state added here because the Indonesia dossier needs a counterpart for its Darul Islam contest zones and Cliopatria has no row. One page (the Darul Islam article) was used; the extents of 1949-1956 and 1958-1961 are inferred from the 1957 estimates and a gap-filler should read the articles on Kartosoewirjo, the Aceh Darul Islam revolt and Kahar Muzakkar. No capital is recorded: the page names none (Kartosoewirjo was captured at Mount Geber near Garut). The extent in West Java is a 70 km circle around Garut cut to West Java ('one-third'), not a surveyed line. South Kalimantan (Ibnu Hadjar) is left out for want of a start date. The Permesta and PRRI rebellions (1957-58) are separate and not on the page.
